email.body1:
Jeff, saw Trackforce shipped new AI TrackTik capabilities and keeps expanding the platform across GuardTek and Silvertrac.

A growing partner ecosystem usually means more co-sell accounts in play than your team can cover, so partner-sourced pipeline never gets worked at scale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the ecosystem autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Trackforce's partner targets off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeff, quick follow-up for Trackforce.

The partnerships bottleneck is rarely the deals, it is coverage: too many partner accounts, not enough hands to work them before they cool. That is exactly where co-sourced pipeline slips through the cracks.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook showing how Trackforce could cover the full partner ecosystem without adding headcount, and the math on meetings it should generate.
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Trackforce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I also had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body4:
Jeff, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most while you are expanding the platform, and I know running channel motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Trackforce either way.
